dashboard.underReviewTitle: Our team is looking at your file
dashboard.underReviewBody: Some points need a human check. We will contact you if we need anything from you.
dashboard.allCaughtUp: You are all caught up for now.
dashboard.paymentLate: A payment is late. Please contact the agency.
dashboard.agencyAppointmentNote: Meeting with the agency — not your visa appointment.
dashboard.helpBody: Tell us about a problem and our team will look at your file.

documents.title: Documents
documents.emptyTitle: Your checklist is not ready yet
documents.emptyBody: Finish the getting-started steps and we will build your personalized list of documents.
documents.generalNote: Documents must be in French, translated into Italian and apostilled where indicated. The Embassy may ask for additional documents or an interview.
documents.humanReview: Our team is checking this with you. There is nothing to upload for now.
documents.dropHint: or drop a file on this card
documents.accepted: Accepted: PDF, JPG, PNG · max {max} MB
documents.uploaded: Document uploaded. Our team will review it.
documents.uploadFailed: The upload failed. Check the file format and size, then try again.
documents.passportRule: Your passport must stay valid for more than {months} months after your visa appointment or submission date — that is, beyond {date}.
documents.passportNoReference: We cannot check your passport yet: no reference date is known.
documents.passportMissing: Add your passport expiry date in your profile.
documents.passportAssumed: Until your visa appointment is known, we use {date} as the reference.
documents.passportFail: Your passport does not stay valid long enough. Please renew it before applying.
documents.passportOk: Your passport is valid for long enough.

payments.title: Payments
payments.description: Your agency fees, what you have paid and what remains.
payments.noOnline: Payments are recorded by the agency. Online payment is not available yet.
payments.empty: No payment plan has been set up for you yet.
payments.history: Every payment you make is recorded here by the agency with its date, method and reference.

appointments.title: Agency appointments
appointments.description: Book a meeting with the agency.
appointments.agencyNote: This is a meeting with the agency. It is not your visa appointment, which is fixed by ALMAVIVA.
appointments.noSlots: No slot is available on this day. Try another date.

applications.title: University applications
applications.description: Each application is independent: you can apply to several universities.
applications.empty: You have not added any application yet.
applications.universitalyEmailHint: ALMAVIVA writes to this address. Check this inbox regularly.
applications.universitalyWarning: ALMAVIVA contacts you by e-mail at the address entered in Universitaly once the university has validated your pre-enrolment and transmitted it to the Embassy. Monitor that inbox, including spam.
applications.noGuarantee: Adding an application does not guarantee admission.

scholarships.title: Scholarships
scholarships.description: Follow the scholarships you apply for.
scholarships.noneTracked: You are not tracking any scholarship yet.
scholarships.noneAvailable: No scholarship is listed for this academic year yet.

visa.title: Visa
visa.noneBody: Your visa file starts once you have been admitted to a university. We will tell you what to do next.
visa.pendingBody: ALMAVIVA will contact you by e-mail, at the address entered in Universitaly, once your validated pre-enrolment has been transmitted to the Embassy. Watch this inbox:
visa.noContactEmail: No Universitaly e-mail address is recorded. Please add it in your applications.
visa.mismatchTitle: Important: course and visa must match
visa.mismatchBody: The course on your visa file differs from the course you plan to enrol in. Enrolling in a different course would require you to return to Tunisia and apply for a new visa. Please contact us before changing anything.
visa.almavivaNote: The visa appointment is given by ALMAVIVA, not by the agency.
visa.datesFixed: ALMAVIVA appointment dates cannot be changed.
visa.processing: Processing can take up to {days} days from the submission of your file.
visa.agencyNoAppointments: The agency cannot obtain, buy or speed up visa appointments.
visa.generalAppointmentDeadline: General deadline for fixing visa appointments
visa.universitalyEnrollmentNote: The Embassy revokes the visas of students who are not enrolled by this date.
visa.permessoBody: Apply for your permesso di soggiorno by this date, counted from your arrival in Italy.
visa.permessoStay: Students waiting for their first permesso should not leave Italy.

help.title: I need help
help.description: Describe the problem. A member of our team will look at your file and get back to you.
help.note: For an emergency, choose “Urgent” and, if you wish, book an appointment with the agency.
help.sentBody: Our team has been notified and will look at your file.
help.bookAppointment: Book an appointment with the agency
help.describeHint: Give as much detail as you can.
help.attachHint: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 5 files.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: Write to the agency team in charge of your file.

profile.title: Profile
profile.locale: Change the language of the app with the selector at the top of the page.
